subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: Launched in 2015 to transform India into a digitally empowered society, this flagship campaign focuses on three areas — digital infrastructure as a core utility, governance and services on demand, and digital empowerment of citizens. It is called:
explanation: Digital India (2015) aims at e-governance, digital infrastructure, and citizen digital literacy — distinct from Make in India (manufacturing/investment promotion) or Skill India (vocational skill development).

subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: A central sector scheme providing direct income support of ₹6,000 per year (in three equal instalments) to all landholding farmer families, transferred directly to bank accounts, is known as:
explanation: PM-KISAN provides direct, unconditional income support to farmer families — distinct from Fasal Bima Yojana (crop insurance against losses) or MGNREGA (guaranteed rural wage employment, not farmer income support).
